messages:
Sam: noticing a noisy eviction ripple in us-east1-c around 03:03 UTC — ~45 small gpu pods got evicted in ~90s, not the large storm but significant.
OpsBot: alert: cluster.evictions.rate jumped from 0.2 to 6.8 evicts/min in us-east1-c at 03:03:12
Ritu: saw rack-sweep kicked off at 03:02:58; it tainted racks to consolidate low-util racks (taint: rack-sweep=true:NoSchedule)
Sam: eviction list is mostly ai-batch-small-* tasks, they all have RequiredDuringSchedulingAffinity to colocate same-team pods
Diego: drain command used was `kubectl drain --force --delete-local-data` which bypasses the eviction API and PDBs -> hard deletes
Priya: bingo. PDBs ignored -> kubelet fallback. Also, warm nodes hit conntrack limits, causing SYN drops and Pending pod hangs
Ritu: rack sweep left a bunch of tiny 0.25 GPU slots distributed across racks; scheduler tried to aggressively pack, preempts overlapped since jitter was tiny
Sam: scheduler logs snippet:
```
I0412 03:03:05 scheduler.go:512] fit failed: PodAffinity conflict with ai-batch-small-7
I0412 03:03:05 scheduler.go:515] preempting pod ai-batch-small-3 on node-9
I0412 03:03:06 scheduler.go:520] eviction API returned error: PDB violation, falling back to force delete
```
Diego: calico stats show conntrack drops rising starting 03:02:50 — explains lease ack timeouts too
Priya: short-term mitigations:
- pause rack-sweep for 30m to avoid repeated fragmentation
- change drain command to use eviction API (honor PDBs) instead of `--force` deletes
- bump nf_conntrack_max on warm nodes to 1.6x and add node-exporter probe for conntrack-drops
- enable scheduler `preemptionJitter=200ms` and `preemptBackoff=30s` in canary before rolling
Ritu: I'll update rack-sweep job to use eviction API and respect PDBs, filing PR now
Diego: I'll spin up 6 extra warm nodes in us-east1-c for 20m to absorb pressure
OpsBot: rack-sweep job paused by Ritu for 30 minutes. Reason: emergency mitigation for fragmentation/evictions
Sam: long-term asks:
- make rack-sweep tolerant to small-batch workloads: convert strict affinities to preferred for pods labeled `batch:small` during drains
- anti-storm throttle: if >N taints applied in AZ within M minutes, switch drains to sequential with a minimal gap
- scheduler alert: if preempt attempts/min > 10 and eviction rate > 5/min -> automatically throttle preempt aggressiveness
Priya: runbook update: never schedule `--force` in automated drains; require `infra/allow-force=true` annotation + 2-person approval for force deletes
Ritu: PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/patch/rack-sweep-pdbs
Diego: status update: eviction rate down to ~1/min after pause and extra nodes are up. Monitoring conntrack metrics.
Priya: filing follow-up INFRA-2244 to track affinity-relax automation + safer drain defaults
Sam: thanks everyone. keep updates short in-thread if anything else happens. :thumbsup:
